verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official Stripe CLI for building, testing, and managing a Stripe integration from the terminal, and that integration includes Terminal; a probe confirms the official CLI docs page exists. missing for 10: Terminal-specific CLI commands (e.g., reader or location management), any AI- or agent-oriented CLI workflow documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use with Terminal.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Stripe CLI helps you build, test, and manage your Stripe integration right from the terminal.
